products.name: EduRestaurant Web
products.tagline: Restaurant billing and orders in the browser.
products.audience: Restaurants, cafes, fast food outlets and takeaways.
intro: Take orders, run the tables and print bills from any browser, at the counter or in the office.
It works with the Restaurant Manager Android app, so waiters can take orders on their phones.
features: Dine-in, takeaway and delivery orders, with table status at a glance.
Quick bills with discounts, taxes and payment type.
Items, categories and prices kept in one place.
Sales and closing reports for the owner.
faq: Do I need to install anything?
No. It runs in the browser; open the demo with the login shown.
Can it work with the Android app?
Yes, the Restaurant Manager app takes orders on the phone.

products.name: EduBS RT Web
products.tagline: Business Solution for retail stores, now in the browser.
products.audience: Retail shops, marts and stores with one or more counters.
intro: The retail edition of Edusoft Business Solution, running in the browser. Counter sales, stock and accounts stay in one system.
features: Fast billing at one or more counters.
Balances and ledgers for every party.
Daily sales, profit and stock reports.
faq: Is this the same as EduBSSTD Web?
It is the retail edition of the same Business Solution, set up for shop counters.
Can I try it now?
Yes. Open the demo with the login shown.

products.name: EduBSSTD Web Edition
products.tagline: Business Solution Standard, now in the browser.
products.audience: Businesses already on the desktop version who want to log in from any PC or branch.
intro: This is the web version of our Business Solution Standard software. Your staff keep the screens they already know, and you stop installing the software on every computer.
It's new, so the demo is still being filled in. Ask us for a walkthrough if something you need isn't there yet.
features: Chrome, Edge or Firefox. Nothing to install on each PC.
Sales, purchases, stock and party ledgers work the way your team is used to.
Every branch and user works on the same data on the server.
faq: Can we move our desktop data across?
Yes. We migrate your existing Business Solution data when we set you up.
Do we need internet all the time?
Yes, it is a web system. If your connection is unreliable, talk to us about a local server.

products.name: EduCampus Core ERP
products.tagline: Admissions, attendance and results for schools and colleges.
products.audience: Schools, colleges and academies, single campus or several.
intro: EduCampus keeps student records, attendance and exam results in one place, so the office isn't chasing registers at the end of every term.
It pairs with EduCampus Finance & Accounts if you also want fee vouchers and school accounts.
features: Student profile, class and section, guardian details and history.
Daily attendance for students and staff, with monthly reports.
Enter marks once and print result cards for the whole class.
Head office can see every branch from one login.
faq: Is there a parent app?
Not in this demo. Tell us if you need one and we'll discuss it.
Can it print our own result card format?
Yes, we set up result cards to match your school's design.

products.name: EduCampus Finance & Accounts
products.tagline: Fee vouchers, collections and school accounts.
products.audience: School and college accounts offices.
intro: Print fee vouchers for every class, record what comes in, and see who hasn't paid. Expenses and ledgers sit in the same system, so month-end doesn't need a separate spreadsheet.
features: Monthly or yearly vouchers for a class or the whole school.
Mark payments and pull a defaulter list by class.
Vouchers, cash book and ledgers for the institution.

products.name: Hospital Management System (HMIS)
products.tagline: Patients, wards, pharmacy, lab and billing in one hospital system.
products.audience: Hospitals and medical centres with several departments.
intro: HMIS is the full hospital package. Reception, doctors, nurses, the lab, the pharmacy and accounts all work on the same patient record.
Every patient gets an MR number at registration, and that number follows them through OPD, admission, tests, medicines and the final bill.
features: MR numbers, OPD and IPD, doctor and nurse screens, vital signs and history.
Bed occupancy, room charges and operation theatre bookings.
Built-in pharmacy and pathology modules. Results go straight to the patient file.
Bills build up automatically as services are added. Panel and insurance patients are supported.
HR, payroll, purchasing and store inventory.
Daily cash, department income, admissions and more.
faq: Can we start with only some modules?
Yes. Many hospitals start with registration, OPD and pharmacy and add the rest later. Each module has its own demo login on this page.
Does it run on our own server?
It can run on your hospital's server or on ours. We'll recommend one after a site visit.

products.name: Poultry Business ERP
products.tagline: Flocks, feed, medicine and farm costs without registers.
products.audience: Poultry farms, sheds and poultry traders.
intro: Record each flock from the day the birds arrive: feed, vaccines, medicine, weight and mortality. At the end you see what the flock actually cost and what it earned.
features: Bird count per shed, transfers and placement dates.
What was given, when and how much.
Track growth and catch problems early.
Expenses per flock and a profit report when it's sold.

products.name: Sanitary Management Software
products.tagline: Schedule sanitation staff and track areas and duties.
products.audience: Facilities, housing schemes, hospitals and municipal sanitation teams.
intro: Assign cleaning duties by area and shift, mark attendance, and see which areas were covered today. Supervisors get the picture without walking every zone.
features: Assign staff to areas and shifts.
Daily attendance and duty records for sanitation staff.
Which zones were cleaned, and which were missed.
Staff, area and monthly reports for management.

products.name: Electric Store Management
products.tagline: Stock, billing and accounts for electrical and electronics shops.
products.audience: Electrical goods retailers and wholesalers.
intro: Built for shops that sell a lot of different items, from wire and switches to fans and appliances. Scan barcodes at the counter, keep stock accurate, and keep track of what each customer and supplier owes.
features: Organise thousands of items by brand and type.
Scan, print the bill and the stock updates itself.
Every transaction is saved and searchable.
Balances and full history for each party.
faq: Is there a mobile app?
Yes. See Electric Store App below. It works with this system.

products.name: Lab & Diagnostic Center Software
products.tagline: From sample collection to the printed report.
products.audience: Diagnostic labs, collection centres and hospital labs.
intro: Each sample is logged at collection and tracked until the report is printed. Reports come out in a standard format, so there's no retyping in Word.
workflow: Register the patient and book tests at the counter.
Label the sample and mark it collected.
Enter results on the technician screen.
Print the report or hand it over at the counter.
features: See the status of every sample at a glance.
Previous reports are stored for repeat patients.

products.name: Patient Registration & Token System
products.tagline: Quick registration and a token queue for each department.
products.audience: Hospital receptions, clinics and OPD counters.
intro: The reception desk registers the patient once and prints a token for the right department. Patients wait for their number instead of crowding the door.
workflow: Patient arrives. Reception searches by phone number or registers a new patient.
Choose the department or doctor and print a token.
The department calls tokens in order.
Visits are logged for daily reports.
features: Repeat patients are found by phone number.
Separate queues for each department or doctor.

products.name: OPD Management System
products.tagline: Appointments, consultations and OPD billing.
products.audience: Outpatient departments and private clinics.
intro: Book appointments by time slot, record the consultation, and take the fee at the counter. The doctor sees the patient's earlier visits on the same screen.
workflow: Book an appointment or take a walk-in.
Doctor records the consultation and prescription.
The counter collects the fee and prints a receipt.
Reports show visits and income per doctor.
features: Receipts and daily cash per counter.

products.name: Financial Accounts
products.tagline: Vouchers, ledgers, budgets and financial statements.
products.audience: Accounts departments.
intro: Standard double-entry accounting: vouchers, ledgers, trial balance, and income and balance sheet statements. Budgets can be set per head and compared with actual spending.
features: Cash, bank and journal vouchers posting to ledgers.
Trial balance, income statement and balance sheet.
Budget versus actual by account head.

products.name: Employee & Payroll
products.tagline: Staff records, leave and monthly salaries.
products.audience: HR and payroll staff.
intro: Keep employee files, leave and attendance in one place, then run the monthly payroll with allowances, deductions and claims worked out for you.
features: Personal details, appraisals and training records.

products.name: Business Solutions Enterprise
products.tagline: ERP for companies with several branches or businesses.
products.audience: Distributors, manufacturers and groups of companies.
intro: Our largest system. It handles several companies and branches under one login, with accounts, stock, purchasing, sales, payroll and banking connected.
Distributors use it for area-wise sales, targets and trade schemes. Manufacturers use it for batch-wise stock and campaigns.
features: Separate books per unit, consolidated where you need it.
Double entry with your own chart of accounts and one-click year closing.
Batch-wise stock, barcodes, several stock holders and stock revaluation.
Tax setup, sales orders, trade schemes, areas and targets.
Biometric attendance, salaries, leave and loans.
Bank accounts, reconciliation, receipts and payments.
Control exactly which screens each user can open.
Balance sheet, stock ageing, working capital and comparisons.
faq: How long does setup take?
It depends on the number of branches and how much old data you have. We'll give you a plan after the first meeting.
Does it work with our biometric machines?
It supports biometric attendance import. Tell us your machine model and we'll confirm.

products.name: Pharmacy Management System
products.tagline: Billing, batches and expiry for pharmacies.
products.audience: Medical stores, pharmacy chains and hospital pharmacies.
intro: Fast counter billing with batch and expiry tracked on every item. Reorder lists come from minimum stock levels, so you order what's actually running out.
Chains get a warehouse and branch transfers, with accounts and payroll built in.
features: Expiry alerts, and min/max levels for each item.
Barcode scanning, discounts and prescription sales.
Reorder lists, purchase returns and supplier payments, by manufacturer.
Stock transfers between the warehouse and shops.
Vouchers, ledgers, income statement and balance sheet.
faq: Can it handle several branches?
Yes. Each branch has its own stock, and head office sees all of them.
Can I see near-expiry stock?
Yes. There's an expiry report, so you can return stock to the supplier in time.

products.name: Digital Invoicing (FBR)
products.tagline: FBR digital invoices with HS codes and provincial tax handled.
products.audience: Sales-tax registered businesses that must issue FBR digital invoices.
intro: Made for Pakistan's FBR digital invoicing requirement. HS codes, units of measure and the correct provincial sales tax are applied automatically, and each invoice is validated before it goes out.
workflow: Set up your products with their HS codes once.
Create the invoice. Tax type and rates are filled in for the buyer's province.
The invoice is validated and submitted.
Keep the digital record for reporting.
features: Codes applied automatically, so you aren't typing them.
Picks the right tax type for each province.

products.name: Restaurant Manager App
products.tagline: Order taking and table management on Android.
products.audience: Restaurants, cafes and fast food outlets.
intro: Waiters take orders on an Android phone at the table, and the order goes straight through. Owners can check the day's sales from anywhere.
features: Menu on the phone, orders sent instantly.
See which tables are free, occupied or waiting for the bill.

products.name: Business Solution App
products.tagline: Orders, stock and balances from your phone.
products.audience: Owners and sales staff who are out of the office.
intro: The Android companion to Business Solution. Book orders in the market, check stock before you promise delivery, and look up what a customer owes.
features: Sales staff book orders on the spot.

products.name: Electric Store App
products.tagline: Your electric store's stock and sales on Android.
products.audience: Electrical shop owners.
intro: Check stock and prices, record a sale, and see the day's takings from your phone. It works with Electric Store Management.
features: Record a sale and share the bill.
Sales and cash for the day.

about: Edusoft System Solutions has been writing business software in Pakistan since 2000. Our clients range from medical stores and restaurants to hospitals, schools and distributors.
Development and support are done by our own team in Multan. Every product can be customised to how your business works, and training for your staff is free, online or at your site.
